# Introduction

This vignette shows how to create a SummarizedExperiment object from an H5AD.

The important steps are: 

1. load counts and metadata stored into H5AD files

2. pre-computing of QC metrics and sizeFactors

3. store object into desired format 



# Example with GSE195510

```{r,message=FALSE}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
```

```{r,message=FALSE}
o <- DropletUtils::read10xCounts("apps/geo_download/downloads/GSE195510/GSE195510_ORGANOIDSEQ_COUNTS_FILTERED.h5ad")
```

## step 2: pre-compute QC metrics and sizeFactors
```{r}
o <- scater::addPerCellQC(o)
o <- scuttle::computeLibraryFactors(o)
```



# Save object
```{r}
HDF5Array::saveHDF5SummarizedExperiment(x,"datasets/GSE195510.h5se")
ABAData::writeSingleCellExperiment(o, "GSE195510.h5txt")
```
